The '''DSP-5 rocket pack''' was a model from [[Zandraman]]. It cost 400 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and was equipped with 12 charges. Each charge allowed for traveling 70 meters vertically and 160 meters horizontally. It carried 60 kilograms of cargo and could support a 45-kilogram being.
